subject.title: feat(agents): add description field for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should configured nonblank `agents.list[].description` values be a supported model-visible metadata field in authorized `agents_list` results?
rationale: The code can preserve existing target authorization, but it cannot choose whether operator-authored configuration text belongs in the permanent model-visible tool contract.

options.title: Adopt the authorized metadata projection
options.body: Accept descriptions as trusted operator-authored capability metadata and merge the existing allowlisted, trimmed optional-field implementation.

options.title: Keep descriptions private
options.body: Reject this projection and retain descriptions solely as configuration and doctor-preserved metadata outside model-visible tool output.

recommendation.title: Adopt the authorized metadata projection
recommendation.body: Accept descriptions as trusted operator-authored capability metadata and merge the existing allowlisted, trimmed optional-field implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged current-main work established the relevant description-metadata preservation contract.
